falcon-17hr5poxpwy.text: The road is open. On to the spaceport.

falcon-1cigfuilk2j.text: You fight well for a Spheroid, Lieutenant.

falcon-1epm7lhhi8n.text: The Atlas has fallen. The flats are ours.

falcon-1i334449nub.text: Star Commander here. We finish what we began, Lieutenant.

falcon-1m8lu25bu90.text: Star Commander here, in Warhawk. I will take that Atlas.

falcon-1n1w76gwxs3.text: The east crate is ours. Hold it.

falcon-1pjfxxsq19l.text: Star Commander here. Fire Moth, Timber Wolf, advance. The town will be ours by nightfall.

falcon-1sie09lqajg.text: Well fought, Lieutenant. We will meet in the town.

falcon-1v1xb5s4hgi.text: Star Commander here. Nothing gets through the Gash. And we are going through them.

falcon-1xyyxfelkh8.text: Star Commander here. The crates are a gift. Falcons take gifts.

falcon-23zmo5gnmw9.text: The Warhammer lies in the orchard. This ground is ours.

falcon-24umrvtwa9b.text: The Lyrans have gone quiet. The post belongs to the Falcons.

falcon-6wn4b3uqdy.text: Star Commander here. Timber Wolf, Pouncer. Take the beacon and Twycross falls.

falcon-8xhpmj35op.text: The Atlas is broken open. Even a giant has bones.

falcon-bpomwdf1ie.text: I am the Star Commander of Clan Jade Falcon. What warrior defends this world? Meet me, one against one.

falcon-flzryw4bvj.text: Over the wall. The Phoenix Hawk could not hold it.

falcon-hk3f6rjh37.text: Star Commander here. Pouncer, over the wall.

falcon-mcfcvy4q4d.text: Twycross belongs to Clan Jade Falcon.

falcon-miq471pqre.text: Star Commander here. Timber Wolf and Nova. We walk to the spaceport, and nobody stops us.

falcon-np33mgiyr7.text: The Fire Moth is through. Twycross is cut off.

falcon-pkb8bc1vsl.text: Star Commander here. Pouncer and Fire Moth. The post is ours by sunrise.

falcon-scmf920nzv.text: The Wraith never landed its punch.

falcon-u67bi667bh.text: Lyran armor, on Falcon mechs. A good trade.

falcon-xygsy4bb43.text: Star Commander here. Pouncer, Fire Moth, take that beacon.

falcon-zrz6q6c9yf.text: The streets are ours. Raise the Falcon over the town.

galaxy-138lb3k12y.text: Galaxy Command: Spend the Nova's guns a little at a time. Do not let it shut down.

galaxy-14dya3kuxdx.text: Galaxy Command: Issue the batchall. Show these Spheroids a Timber Wolf. Then walk away with your honor.

galaxy-15tsmp0iv4t.text: Galaxy Command: Star Commander, the Lyrans are listening. Take it now.

galaxy-1cqtpob1596.text: Galaxy Command: Star Commander, do not stop in the open. Keep walking.

galaxy-1gps1lmuhxl.text: Galaxy Command: Keep your back away from the Atlas. Crack its structure.

galaxy-1iq0jcy4jn6.text: Hold the center beacon. First to 2, or the last side standing.

galaxy-1ruxycrrx9n.text: Galaxy Command: Stay moving. A still Dasher is a dead Dasher.

galaxy-1t5aryyvlii.text: Galaxy Command: Take the town. The Fire Moth is fast and thin. Give it a wall.

galaxy-1vh3r71fn8u.text: Get a mech off the far edge, or knock out the other side.

galaxy-1z6kntxqz8k.text: Galaxy Command: Walk through them. Your guns are better.

galaxy-23u02lkk0ol.text: Galaxy Command: The Fire Moth runs. The Warhawk stops the Wasp.

galaxy-24li1d04s57.text: Galaxy Command: Cross the orchard without wasting your move in the trees.

galaxy-25c695wyzcw.text: Galaxy Command: Star Commander, the edge is close. Sprint.

galaxy-2i5ri5omhh.text: Galaxy Command: The Warhawk hits hard even far away. You choose the distance.

galaxy-5y63jdne6.text: Score the beacons. First to 2, or the last side standing.

galaxy-7py1i3iuu5.text: Galaxy Command: The Fire Moth runs to the post. The Pouncer clears it.

galaxy-8efhzqzq7q.text: Galaxy Command: Take one crate and hold it. Then take the other.

galaxy-ej1a9btlsi.text: Galaxy Command: Jump the wall and make the Phoenix Hawk come to you.

galaxy-ge9xuefar5.text: Galaxy Command: Take the beacon before the Lyrans can call for help.

galaxy-jb7rxdr9v5.text: Galaxy Command: The Pouncer jumps for the beacon. The Timber Wolf shoots past it.

galaxy-y03k27c3i2.text: Galaxy Command: Keep a little space. Your guns are the fight.

garrison-135pkghlaxz.text: Garrison Command: The port crews are watching. Hold that ridge.

garrison-14qbafc62jm.text: Garrison Command: Answer the batchall. Learn the shot. Walk away when the two turns are done.

garrison-173y4ya2r39.text: Garrison Command: One more point and Twycross can hear again.

garrison-1aazjbs8ljx.text: Armor is the metal skin. Structure is the bones underneath.

garrison-1g4lezvhxm9.text: Garrison, we hear you. Help is coming, Lieutenant.

garrison-1hi31qxglz2.text: Garrison Command: The Phoenix Hawk takes the beacon. The Warhammer holds the lane.

garrison-1k60lrvr9d0.text: Garrison Command: Lieutenant, stop them on the ridge. Use the buildings. Do not let them reach the port.

garrison-1li8tw7fbq4.text: Score the beacons. First to 2, or the last side standing.

garrison-1m39ghdqo43.text: Garrison Command: Let the Nova cook. Make it walk to you.

garrison-1okukvxv3jx.text: Garrison Command, all units: the edge of town, and the listening post beacon is back in the center.

garrison-1pkuwktwntk.text: Garrison Command, all units: the duel is over and the Falcons are moving into town.

garrison-1qenb041eib.text: Garrison Command: Get behind the Warhawk. The back is the soft part.

garrison-205vn7fa2ph.text: Garrison Command: a town wall stands between our line and theirs.

garrison-2694iogm44b.text: Garrison Command: Use the orchard. Make the Mad Cat pay for every inch.

garrison-2dl75dp7wk0.text: Garrison Command: the Falcons have pushed us onto the salt flats. It is hot out here.

garrison-2dwzpqraoqe.text: Garrison Command: Falcon assault contact on the open flats.

garrison-2e1f0jn4dq7.text: Garrison Command: Get a mech on the beacon and keep the Falcons off it.

garrison-2e2mligd5qi.text: Contact. One Clan light, moving fast across the flats.

garrison-2eimzj3nib8.text: Garrison Command: The Wasp takes the post. The Warhammer guards it.

garrison-2eqo4cd11la.text: Garrison Command: Catch the Dasher. Make it stand still if you can.

garrison-2fphq43tklh.text: Garrison Command: Hold the town. Use the buildings and the trees.

garrison-2gee0t9f517.text: Garrison Command: Get the Wraith in close. The Nova wants room to shoot.

garrison-36n3xo66t5.text: Garrison Command: Split up. One mech on each crate.

garrison-37dm1z1goz.text: Hold the center beacon. First to 2, or the last side standing.

garrison-d23210w6tu.text: Garrison Command: the Mad Cat from the duel is back, in the orchards outside town.

garrison-d988dkoj3k.text: Garrison Command: the Falcons followed us into a narrow cut of the Great Gash, the huge canyon on Twycross.

garrison-i366fr7f2g.text: Garrison Command: Lieutenant, those crates keep the garrison fighting. Get them.

garrison-jf5xyefv3l.text: Garrison Command: our listening post in the middle of town is still transmitting. The token in the center is its beacon. Whoever holds it alone can call down help. For us that means reinforcements. For the Falcons it means their DropShips.

garrison-jjljkrtjyo.text: Garrison Command: Lieutenant, get a mech to the far edge. Everything depends on it.

garrison-l1z63f3c92.text: Garrison Command, all units: the listening post is back on the air. Whoever holds it hears every order on Twycross.

garrison-mo15jbh9fh.text: Garrison Command: Jump the wall when walking would take too long. Then decide if you shoot.

garrison-sqbs1u1il4.text: Get a mech off the far edge, or knock out the other side.

garrison-w5mane3iz7.text: Garrison Command: The Atlas is slow. Make the long ground work for you.

garrison-w94rnzkjk4.text: Garrison Command, all units: the town stays Lyran. The Lieutenant holds the streets.

garrison-yq5if1ddz1.text: Garrison Command: Hold the ridge. Make every shot count.

garrison-ywc6cl8ta.text: Garrison Command: The Wasp runs. The Atlas blocks the road.

lyran-15owzwurpue.text: Got inside its guns. The Nova is down.

lyran-1pckcuo9qy5.text: I can see the west crate. Moving in.

lyran-1txeojyoy3s.text: Mad Cat down in the trees.

lyran-1wai6u71dll.text: Masakari down. The Atlas is walking off the flats.

lyran-1yyi0bvht52.text: Twycross Garrison. One Warhammer. I will meet you.

lyran-23ylqjk6g7c.text: The post is ours. We hear everything now.

lyran-29fbejyrdp5.text: Garrison, Twycross holds for one more day.

lyran-29loed858fx.text: The Wasp is through. The message is out.

lyran-2f7w8xcq3i3.text: Smoke on the ridge. Somebody is hurt.

lyran-9wyzqd64ua.text: Garrison, the Warhammer is still standing. The Falcon is pulling back.

lyran-b0foapck6w.text: Hit the Masakari in the back. Structure breached. It is down.

lyran-g47s30jwcs.text: Both crates are home. The garrison eats tonight.

lyran-j5wmgm85pk.text: The wall is held. The Pouncer is down on the far side.

lyran-qyz61rgkxb.text: Ridge road is clear. The port is safe.

narrator-105w4w3kvef.text: Jump the Wasp onto the post. It is small, so keep it near cover.

narrator-107a9w4wj3h.text: The Nova hits hard up close. Stay past 6 inches and make it walk to you.

narrator-10nq8rw3jk9.text: A hit in the back of the base marks one extra bubble. Armor bubbles go first, then red structure bubbles. If structure is marked and the mech is still standing, roll two dice and read the critical hit table on the tables card in the box. A roll of 12 does that even if only armor was marked. The mech comes off the table when the last structure bubble is marked.

narrator-10rwubqzijf.text: You cannot punch and shoot in the same turn.

narrator-10xp450spqv.text: You are 1 harder to hit, on top of your TMM, because you jumped.

narrator-12i31d0cg6f.text: The beacon calls the Falcon DropShips.

narrator-12v0qtrlwsq.text: If the card has a jump move, a jump makes that mech harder to hit.

narrator-12wpm1zkwi2.text: When two turns are done, pull back. Zellbrigen is kept.

narrator-13096o1iq0y.text: A jump move is the inches next to the j on the card. Jumping ignores trees and buildings. It cannot jump out of water. A mech that jumped adds 2 to its own shot, and 1 on top of its TMM when someone shoots it.

narrator-13fyvanxod1.text: If you do not shoot, erase the heat.

narrator-13xi9wmtezu.text: Every shot makes a mech Hot, and a Hot mech's next shot needs one more.

narrator-159ib6xr6bu.text: Park the Fire Moth against a building or in the trees.

narrator-15casv3pyqy.text: TMM is the target movement modifier on the card. A mech that walked or sprinted adds its TMM to the number you need. A mech that moved less than 1 inch stood still: its TMM is 0, and its own shot is one easier.

narrator-15hfdk3cciy.text: The Lyrans fall back to the city.

narrator-15sw1r18snt.text: You have 1 armor and 1 structure. One hit knocks you out.

narrator-1658masm6vg.text: Teaching heat: a mech that shoots is Hot next turn, and its shot needs one more. If it does not shoot, it cools off. A mech alone on the beacon at the end of the turn scores 1. First to 2, or the last side standing.

narrator-16g0njpcjyb.text: Hold the center beacon. First to 2, or the last side standing.

narrator-16nlu3fm8w0.text: The OV on the card is how much extra damage you may add at short or medium range. You choose it before you roll. At the end of the turn, mark that much heat. Your heat is added to your next weapon shot. Twice your heat comes off your walk inches. At heat 2 or more, TMM drops by 1 unless you jump. Heat 4 shuts the mech down for a turn. If you do not shoot, erase the heat. Water cools one heat if you did shoot.

narrator-17uplh95ror.text: Long adds 4 to the number the dice need. Medium adds 2.

narrator-18fy6hwynig.text: With two objectives you have to choose. Split up to score both, or stay together and be safer. Check each crate on its own at the end of the turn.

narrator-18xibvpvira.text: The Timber Wolf can shoot from farther down the street.

narrator-197b6st0ita.text: Your Nova can add 4 overheat. 1 or 2 is safe.

narrator-199way0dnwh.text: The Star Commander walks out in a Timber Wolf. Inner Sphere pilots call it a Mad Cat, because it looks like two of their mechs mashed together. Under zellbrigen, the Clan code of honor, the duel is one on one, and when it is done both pilots pull back. Nobody loses.

narrator-1a69z1u19b7.text: Get a mech off the far edge, or knock out the other side.

narrator-1a96wbgdnp1.text: Formations, pilot cards, and battlefield support stay off.

narrator-1acmtvxnppt.text: Nobody gets through the Gash. The radio stays quiet one more night.

narrator-1adu4owfztj.text: Walking through trees costs 2 inches for every inch you travel.

narrator-1b01feudiof.text: The Pouncer can jump onto the beacon.

narrator-1bb8anwegq0.text: Trees in the way, or a target standing in trees, are also one harder.

narrator-1d8y10z5bc9.text: Both jumpers fall. The wall stands empty.

narrator-1d9euef7ml.text: The Timber Wolf shoots well past 6 inches. You can stay there.

narrator-1dclorfnak2.text: A punch reaches 1 inch and marks bubbles equal to your size.

narrator-1dmh3rw3llo.text: 4 shuts you down next turn, and a still mech is easy to hit.

narrator-1g1n350hc38.text: The Warhammer is your big gun. Keep it where it can see down a street.

narrator-1g22yxbu8hb.text: A charge must end touching a mech that already moved.

narrator-1gltcjklic2.text: A hit through the back of the base marks one extra bubble.

narrator-1gv8kudflzf.text: Two points wins, even if the Warhammer is still standing.

narrator-1h3jk7114up.text: The Clan side holds the field.

narrator-1h9hld9l0ty.text: The listening post crackles. Both sides can hear it.

narrator-1hco544e1hl.text: The Masakari outshot the Lyran giant.

narrator-1hmbc3xzdkr.text: The Nova and the Pouncer both jump. Land next to a building for cover.

narrator-1hnqozfki5b.text: The Lieutenant has a Wasp. The Star Commander has a Fire Moth. The Clans call it a Dasher. It is the fastest mech in this box, and one good hit can knock it out. A mech that moves is harder to hit. A mech that stands still is easier to hit, and its own shot is easier.

narrator-1j3gehipqw.text: Static on every channel. Only short range radios work in the Gash.

narrator-1j57su7ykif.text: Stay inside 24 inches so your guns can hit.

narrator-1jre1kgt9s2.text: Two commanders brought their own lances. The map shows where the terrain goes. Read each special on the card out loud, then play the turn you already know.

narrator-1jtxra1qut0.text: From here on, the number to beat uses the real range bands. Short, up to 6 inches, adds nothing. Medium, past 6 and up to 24, adds 2. Long, past 24 and up to 42, adds 4. Past 42 is too far. Damage still comes from that box on the card.

narrator-1lpn6iht9z6.text: Both scouts break off and go silent. The race ends even.

narrator-1lreyulvawx.text: The Nova's guns finished it before the heat could shut them down.

narrator-1lw11ozrbyk.text: Past 42 is too far. Your Atlas hits hardest inside 24 inches.

narrator-1mdchl8g2rp.text: This is the whole quick-start turn: initiative, move, the shot number, heat, rear, crits, punches, sprints, charges, and death from above. Read any special ability on the card out loud and use the card. Formations, pilot cards, and battlefield support stay off.

narrator-1mmrm6w3maw.text: The Lieutenant has a Phoenix Hawk and a Wasp. Clan channel:

narrator-1muth85vyzh.text: The Wraith jumps. It will try to land on you.

narrator-1nllr6olq25.text: There is nowhere to hide, so distance is the whole fight. The Lieutenant brings an Atlas. It is the biggest Lyran mech in the box, and its skull face was built to make enemies afraid. Clan channel:

narrator-1nn03wvfhw.text: Medium, past 6 and up to 24, adds 2. Long, past 24 and up to 42, adds 4.

narrator-1o2xyh1sa64.text: If you hold both crates in one turn, you win right away.

narrator-1of89n342b7.text: The Warhawk shoots far. Watch the Wasp and shoot it when it lands.

narrator-1ole3w3gvaw.text: The beacon calls the Falcons down.

narrator-1p3ejwmcoak.text: Mark the bubbles the coach names. Armor first, then the red ones.

narrator-1phgpvwac6t.text: Be the only one touching the beacon at the end of a turn to score 1. First to 2 wins. Knocking out every enemy mech also wins.

narrator-1pxz8ls9uli.text: There are two crates. At the end of each turn, check each crate. Whoever is alone touching it scores 1.

narrator-1pzql2xyghy.text: If you do punch, the damage is your size.

narrator-1qvc1j68o8s.text: Someone shooting at you adds 1 on top of your TMM because you jumped.

narrator-1rt2huando3.text: Hide two-thirds of the Timber Wolf behind a building when you can.

narrator-1t5mexe3e9b.text: The Timber Wolf hits hard at medium range. Keep it there.

narrator-1tbg8tmkcz7.text: Both sides are trying to break through. A mech that walks off the other home edge scores, and one score wins.

narrator-1tdb1oftghd.text: Jump the Phoenix Hawk to the beacon. The Warhammer shoots whoever comes close.

narrator-1teciwrveav.text: If it overheats, it gets slow. Heat takes inches off its walk.

narrator-1tq19faxhw1.text: The Atlas has 10 armor. You will need more than one hit.

narrator-1unn8fw4q2k.text: Only one side touching the post scores. If both sides touch it, nobody scores that turn. A fast mech gets there first, but a slow mech with big guns can push it off.

narrator-1v6l8xh99ev.text: The Timber Wolf walks off still standing. Honor is kept, and nobody is called the loser.

narrator-1waplpfkyer.text: The Atlas is slow but huge. Stand it where the Fire Moth wants to run.

narrator-1wyqevxsa7y.text: The Nova kept just enough room to shoot.

narrator-1x57kadj611.text: The Lieutenant brings a Warhammer and a Wasp. Clan channel:

narrator-1xcqspju5b6.text: The beacon goes quiet. Neither side holds Twycross tonight.

narrator-1xhg8rgdf4k.text: Your Warhammer can add 1 overheat. That is one extra bubble, and one heat.

narrator-1xr9tu3iy80.text: One mech off the far edge wins.

narrator-1xwy4pb52sv.text: Two mechs on one crate is safe, but it only scores 1.

narrator-1yetgd8qhyr.text: That challenge is a batchall. The Lieutenant keys the radio:

narrator-1zk7gv2ofgu.text: Both mechs go dark in the heat. The salt flats win.

narrator-1zmgpduz0lt.text: The Lieutenant takes the Warhammer in after it. Clan channel:

narrator-1zzm0g5hs36.text: The Falcons turn back into the hills.

narrator-21itwxv2i4f.text: Short, up to 6 inches, adds nothing to the number you need.

narrator-221rofxin39.text: Both giants fall. Nobody answers on either channel.

narrator-234vtl3u0uq.text: If you shoot, you are Hot next turn.

narrator-23wb95l8wq4.text: A full table changes the fight. Buildings block the line of sight, trees make a mech harder to hit, and walking through trees costs extra inches. Before you move, look at the map and pick the spot you want to end on.

narrator-24he62szrli.text: If two-thirds of the enemy is behind a building, the shot is one harder.

narrator-24iac1ojh92.text: First to 2 beacon points wins, even if both sides are still standing.

narrator-24m4ub487fp.text: When structure is marked, the tables card says what broke.

narrator-24wj034ivs5.text: The Dasher lives. Speed wins this race.

narrator-25fmuwjzd3w.text: The Lieutenant's Atlas has a lot of both. The Star Commander's Warhawk does too. A hit in the back marks one extra bubble. When the red structure bubbles get marked, something inside can break. That is a critical hit.

narrator-25tgofhuxps.text: Use the Warhammer side labeled 8R and the Timber Wolf side labeled Prime. The other sides are not an even match. The skill spot is blank, so both pilots are regular and the dice need 4. Count the armor bubbles and the red structure bubbles once. The coach keeps that count. Mark the same bubbles on the card. After two turns, both pilots pull back. Nobody loses.

narrator-25xcqwvdtgr.text: Deployment is the strip along your home edge.

narrator-261oge8v961.text: Both assault mechs break. The crits take them together.

narrator-26vblklfzj5.text: Read any special ability on the card out loud, then use the card.

narrator-2797efxqs2s.text: Both mechs fall among the trees. The orchard goes quiet.

narrator-27btakg5bwc.text: Every lesson comes together here. This is a full quick-start turn: move, shoot, heat, the back armor, crits, punches, sprints, and charges.

narrator-27kjdlafpdk.text: The Pouncer jumps 10 inches, over the wall and the trees.

narrator-2829u47vlry.text: The Atlas is slow. You can walk away and keep the range you want.

narrator-285aowrc77g.text: The Fire Moth is the fastest mech in the box. Sprint it for the edge.

narrator-28t0kfhmv9d.text: The post goes silent. Neither side can use it tonight.

narrator-2alxf7dh43b.text: New choices: if the card has a jump move, you may jump. A mech that jumped is one harder to hit. A mech touching a building or standing in trees is one harder to hit. This is the teaching version of cover, not the full table.

narrator-2aq27oxoid4.text: Both pilots raise a hand and walk back. The batchall is answered.

narrator-2bs17uw3l57.text: A mech that jumped is one harder to hit.

narrator-2bzw3w2xwi8.text: The Wasp is fast and jumps. Send it around the buildings.

narrator-2ddvsz2db67.text: The Warhammer still has heat to spare.

narrator-2e7nvba25v4.text: The crates sit in the street, smoking. Nobody carries them home.

narrator-2exvq6us6vf.text: The Fire Moth is fast, and one hit knocks it out. Use it to grab the beacon.

narrator-2faejfk6a97.text: Mechs carry fusion engines, and every shot makes them hotter. The Star Commander's Nova has more guns than it can keep cool. The Lieutenant answers in the Warhammer.

narrator-2fldp4ol7rs.text: Your TMM is 4 while you move. Standing still drops that to 0.

narrator-2fq777smzsf.text: Do not let the Phoenix Hawk land behind you.

narrator-2ga7bkyj4aq.text: Clear ground costs 1 inch of move per inch you travel. Trees cost 2. A climb costs extra, and a step up steeper than 2 inches is not allowed. Jumping skips those costs. If two-thirds of the target is hidden by a building, a hill, or water, the shot is one harder. Trees in the way, or a target standing in trees, are also one harder. Trees do not count as that hiding cover.

narrator-2gd6o7pn7k5.text: The Lieutenant has the Warhammer and the Phoenix Hawk. Clan channel:

narrator-2mxte02xmp.text: The Blackjack jumps. It can hop onto the near crate and shoot.

narrator-30l4yim4w4.text: The post is the token in the middle. Be the only side touching it at the end of a turn to score.

narrator-3teyq0v9aw.text: Your long box is 6. You can shoot from across the flats.

narrator-52s3rcdy5m.text: Turn so the Atlas shoots your front. The back would add a bubble.

narrator-55xz7g149j.text: The beacon reaches the Lyran line.

narrator-6gto2lishu.text: Push the Lyrans off a crate and it is nobody's.

narrator-6yv93aseh2.text: Both sides pull out. The streets are empty, and every channel goes quiet.

narrator-73c64q57u3.text: A mech that shoots is Hot next turn. That shot needs one more.

narrator-7nhn6s90hl.text: The Phoenix Hawk jumps. Use it to get behind the Timber Wolf.

narrator-7v63wu4o28.text: Play two turns, then both pilots pull back. Nobody loses. A shot that would knock a mech out ends the fight the same way.

narrator-8hi18q05m7.text: Jump the Pouncer onto anything touching the post.

narrator-8j5vz2rcsf.text: The Nova jumps. Use the trees so it is harder to hit.

narrator-8sj7m26b5o.text: The Archer shoots far. Park it behind a building and fire over the open ground.

narrator-93sertrfxe.text: Within 6 inches, use the short box. Past 6, use the medium box.

narrator-9b0hx0gox9.text: Hits in the back mark an extra bubble.

narrator-9o745qt8su.text: Both stars lie broken on the ridge. Nobody reaches the port tonight.

narrator-aa01c8mavi.text: Armor bubbles go first. Then the red structure bubbles.

narrator-aa7df8u3um.text: Your own shot is 2 harder in the turn you jump.

narrator-af0sjy8tz9.text: Put the Pouncer on the beacon and the Timber Wolf where it can see.

narrator-aqw7yowkft.text: Put each piece where the map numbers it.

narrator-bsujz1857n.text: Leave a gap so the bases do not touch, and you can still shoot.

narrator-dq8mvnu17w.text: Standing still makes your own shot one easier, and your TMM drops to 0.

narrator-duwbszbkee.text: A jump adds 2 to your own shot. Land first if you need an easier roll next turn.

narrator-gly0i9b0m3.text: They meet in the middle and both fall. The Gash keeps the wrecks.

narrator-gr1v8w6mkj.text: The Fire Moth is very fast. Shoot it when it stops.

narrator-id803anfkk.text: At the end of each turn, score 1 for each crate only your mechs touch. First to 2 wins. Knocking out every enemy mech also wins.

narrator-imere7moi.text: This is the whole quick-start turn from the box: initiative, move, the shot number, heat, rear, crits, punches, sprints, charges, and death from above. Sprint is one and a half times the walk inches, rounded up, and that mech cannot shoot. A charge is declared while moving, only at a mech that already moved, and you must end touching it. Read any special ability on the card out loud and use the card. The tables card still decides crits. Formations, pilot cards, and battlefield support stay in the box for another day.

narrator-j5xpfe56d0.text: If the bases are touching, you cannot shoot that mech. A punch reaches 1 inch, hits on the skill number plus the usual movement and cover modifiers, and marks bubbles equal to the mech's size. If the card says MEL, that melee reach is 2 inches and the damage is size plus 1. You cannot punch and shoot in the same turn.

narrator-juh2bzab6p.text: The Inner Sphere side holds the field.

narrator-kcd587jgha.text: Sprint is one and a half times your walk, and that mech cannot shoot.

narrator-kqf4h0acxe.text: A jump would skip the tree cost. This mech does not jump, so walk the open lane.

narrator-ktd73yvn35.text: Get a mech off the other side's home edge to win. Knocking out every enemy mech also wins.

narrator-lizemmavmv.text: The Inner Sphere calls that mech a Masakari.

narrator-ljrvdzfvl6.text: The Fire Moth dies to one solid hit. A still Dasher is the shot you want.

narrator-ls2d49yooy.text: A jump uses the inches next to the j. It ignores trees and buildings.

narrator-lwbip53ey9.text: A move under 1 inch counts as standing still, and that shot is one easier.

narrator-m460cm378j.text: The Wasp caught it. Fast is not the same as safe.

narrator-mf0qsly27n.text: Honor is kept, and nobody is called the loser.

narrator-n7sr379wxv.text: You score only when no enemy mech is also touching the beacon.

narrator-othus3v8gd.text: Twycross, 3050. Clan Jade Falcon has landed. Open channel:

narrator-ozwheme9oc.text: Be the only one touching the listening post at the end of a turn to score 1. First to 2 wins. Knocking out every enemy mech also wins.

narrator-p0y5zz1mcp.text: A mech against a wall, or standing in the trees, is harder to hit. A mech that jumps is harder to hit too.

narrator-plh834mdsb.text: The beacon fight is over, but the Falcons are not done. A Clan star is walking the ridge road toward the spaceport.

narrator-pmryl7y2m.text: Clear ground costs 1 inch of move per inch you walk. Trees cost 2.

narrator-rg01rjs51n.text: One crate has split open. Spare armor plates lie in the street.

narrator-ro3jt38717.text: When the goal is an edge, speed matters more than guns. A fast mech that sprints can reach the edge, but it cannot shoot that turn. Slow mechs win by standing in the way.

narrator-rrr8ac8apk.text: The beacon gets through on the Lyran band:

narrator-s7o198xh3.text: If the bases are touching, you cannot shoot that mech. Punch it.

narrator-tavvf1wlyq.text: Jump the Phoenix Hawk onto the beacon, then hold fire so it cools.

narrator-tb76dx0jbg.text: Both pilots have to think about the ground, not just the guns. Trees cost extra inches to walk through. A building can hide most of a mech.

narrator-tejiynjjtw.text: A cargo ship drops two supply crates over the town. Ammo, armor, and spare parts. Both sides saw them fall.

narrator-trpmkjpdb8.text: Sprint is one and a half times your walk, but that mech cannot shoot.

narrator-tscic8bxw7.text: The Fire Moth reaches the post first. Keep it moving so it is hard to hit.

narrator-v6tlo4dy7m.text: If structure is marked and the mech is still up, roll the critical hit table.

narrator-v8aus8zt5d.text: Buildings and trees break up the streets. The Lieutenant takes a Wasp and a Warhammer. Intercepted on the Clan channel:

narrator-vup9qgvvvz.text: The beacon goes quiet. Nobody held it long enough to be heard.

narrator-w1ss47742z.text: After two turns you both leave. Zellbrigen holds the Falcon to that too.

narrator-wgf1y7c4tw.text: The Wraith is fast. Send it to the far crate.

narrator-x66sfrridy.text: Both mechs can jump the wall. Jumping ignores trees and buildings. A jump makes your own shot harder, and it makes you a little harder to hit.

narrator-xqy73o1kiv.text: In here the mechs get too close to shoot. The Lieutenant brings a Wraith, a fast mech with fists. The Star Commander brings the Nova. When the bases touch, you punch. You do not shoot.

narrator-y0vd613n4i.text: Put the Wasp against a building or in the trees. That makes it harder to hit.

narrator-y1kwwqx6gt.text: The Lieutenant brings a Phoenix Hawk. Clan channel:

narrator-y4k36pzvmv.text: Score the beacons. First to 2, or the last side standing.

narrator-ylkrueatan.text: No beacon tonight. This is a stand-up fight with every rule you know.

narrator-yqp7c7glow.text: The Falcons have jammed the radio. The garrison needs one mech to run through the Great Gash and carry the message out.

narrator-ytutm3iv6e.text: The Warhammer is slow. Put it where it can see the post.

narrator-zn6ccyx64k.text: Your Wasp is fast. Moving adds its TMM, so it is harder to hit.

captions.text: Galaxy Command: Take the beacon before the Lyrans can call for help.
The Pouncer can jump onto the beacon.
The Fire Moth is fast, and one hit knocks it out. Use it to grab the beacon.
If you shoot, you are Hot next turn.
Garrison Command: Get a mech on the beacon and keep the Falcons off it.
Jump the Phoenix Hawk onto the beacon, then hold fire so it cools.
A mech that shoots is Hot next turn. That shot needs one more.
You score only when no enemy mech is also touching the beacon.
Galaxy Command: Keep your back away from the Atlas. Crack its structure.
Turn so the Atlas shoots your front. The back would add a bubble.
The Atlas has 10 armor. You will need more than one hit.
When structure is marked, the tables card says what broke.
Garrison Command: Get behind the Warhawk. The back is the soft part.
A hit through the back of the base marks one extra bubble.
Armor bubbles go first. Then the red structure bubbles.
If structure is marked and the mech is still up, roll the critical hit table.
Galaxy Command: Issue the batchall. Show these Spheroids a Timber Wolf. Then walk away with your honor.
The Timber Wolf shoots well past 6 inches. You can stay there.
Mark the bubbles the coach names. Armor first, then the red ones.
When two turns are done, pull back. Zellbrigen is kept.
Garrison Command: Answer the batchall. Learn the shot. Walk away when the two turns are done.
Stay inside 24 inches so your guns can hit.
Within 6 inches, use the short box. Past 6, use the medium box.
After two turns you both leave. Zellbrigen holds the Falcon to that too.
Galaxy Command: Spend the Nova's guns a little at a time. Do not let it shut down.
Your Nova can add 4 overheat. 1 or 2 is safe.
4 shuts you down next turn, and a still mech is easy to hit.
If you do not shoot, erase the heat.
Garrison Command: Let the Nova cook. Make it walk to you.
The Nova hits hard up close. Stay past 6 inches and make it walk to you.
If it overheats, it gets slow. Heat takes inches off its walk.
Your Warhammer can add 1 overheat. That is one extra bubble, and one heat.
Galaxy Command: The Warhawk hits hard even far away. You choose the distance.
Your long box is 6. You can shoot from across the flats.
The Atlas is slow. You can walk away and keep the range you want.
Long adds 4 to the number the dice need. Medium adds 2.
Garrison Command: The Atlas is slow. Make the long ground work for you.
Short, up to 6 inches, adds nothing to the number you need.
Medium, past 6 and up to 24, adds 2. Long, past 24 and up to 42, adds 4.
Past 42 is too far. Your Atlas hits hardest inside 24 inches.
Galaxy Command: Jump the wall and make the Phoenix Hawk come to you.
The Pouncer jumps 10 inches, over the wall and the trees.
Your own shot is 2 harder in the turn you jump.
You are 1 harder to hit, on top of your TMM, because you jumped.
Garrison Command: Jump the wall when walking would take too long. Then decide if you shoot.
A jump uses the inches next to the j. It ignores trees and buildings.
A jump adds 2 to your own shot. Land first if you need an easier roll next turn.
Someone shooting at you adds 1 on top of your TMM because you jumped.
Galaxy Command: The Fire Moth runs to the post. The Pouncer clears it.
The Fire Moth reaches the post first. Keep it moving so it is hard to hit.
Jump the Pouncer onto anything touching the post.
Two points wins, even if the Warhammer is still standing.
Garrison Command: The Wasp takes the post. The Warhammer guards it.
Jump the Wasp onto the post. It is small, so keep it near cover.
The Warhammer is slow. Put it where it can see the post.
The Fire Moth is very fast. Shoot it when it stops.
Galaxy Command: Walk through them. Your guns are better.
The Timber Wolf hits hard at medium range. Keep it there.
The Nova jumps. Use the trees so it is harder to hit.
Do not let the Phoenix Hawk land behind you.
Garrison Command: Hold the ridge. Make every shot count.
The Archer shoots far. Park it behind a building and fire over the open ground.
The Phoenix Hawk jumps. Use it to get behind the Timber Wolf.
Hits in the back mark an extra bubble.
Galaxy Command: Take the town. The Fire Moth is fast and thin. Give it a wall.
Park the Fire Moth against a building or in the trees.
The Timber Wolf can shoot from farther down the street.
A mech that jumped is one harder to hit.
Garrison Command: Hold the town. Use the buildings and the trees.
Put the Wasp against a building or in the trees. That makes it harder to hit.
The Warhammer is your big gun. Keep it where it can see down a street.
If the card has a jump move, a jump makes that mech harder to hit.
Galaxy Command: Take one crate and hold it. Then take the other.
The Nova and the Pouncer both jump. Land next to a building for cover.
Two mechs on one crate is safe, but it only scores 1.
Push the Lyrans off a crate and it is nobody's.
Garrison Command: Split up. One mech on each crate.
The Wraith is fast. Send it to the far crate.
The Blackjack jumps. It can hop onto the near crate and shoot.
If you hold both crates in one turn, you win right away.
Galaxy Command: The Pouncer jumps for the beacon. The Timber Wolf shoots past it.
Put the Pouncer on the beacon and the Timber Wolf where it can see.
A charge must end touching a mech that already moved.
First to 2 beacon points wins, even if both sides are still standing.
Garrison Command: The Phoenix Hawk takes the beacon. The Warhammer holds the lane.
Jump the Phoenix Hawk to the beacon. The Warhammer shoots whoever comes close.
Sprint is one and a half times your walk, and that mech cannot shoot.
Read any special ability on the card out loud, then use the card.
Galaxy Command: Stay moving. A still Dasher is a dead Dasher.
Your TMM is 4 while you move. Standing still drops that to 0.
You have 1 armor and 1 structure. One hit knocks you out.
A move under 1 inch counts as standing still, and that shot is one easier.
Garrison Command: Catch the Dasher. Make it stand still if you can.
Your Wasp is fast. Moving adds its TMM, so it is harder to hit.
Standing still makes your own shot one easier, and your TMM drops to 0.
The Fire Moth dies to one solid hit. A still Dasher is the shot you want.
Galaxy Command: The Fire Moth runs. The Warhawk stops the Wasp.
The Fire Moth is the fastest mech in the box. Sprint it for the edge.
The Warhawk shoots far. Watch the Wasp and shoot it when it lands.
One mech off the far edge wins.
Garrison Command: The Wasp runs. The Atlas blocks the road.
The Wasp is fast and jumps. Send it around the buildings.
The Atlas is slow but huge. Stand it where the Fire Moth wants to run.
Sprint is one and a half times your walk, but that mech cannot shoot.
Galaxy Command: Cross the orchard without wasting your move in the trees.
Walking through trees costs 2 inches for every inch you travel.
Hide two-thirds of the Timber Wolf behind a building when you can.
A jump would skip the tree cost. This mech does not jump, so walk the open lane.
Garrison Command: Use the orchard. Make the Mad Cat pay for every inch.
Clear ground costs 1 inch of move per inch you walk. Trees cost 2.
If two-thirds of the enemy is behind a building, the shot is one harder.
Trees in the way, or a target standing in trees, are also one harder.
Galaxy Command: Keep a little space. Your guns are the fight.
Leave a gap so the bases do not touch, and you can still shoot.
If you do punch, the damage is your size.
The Wraith jumps. It will try to land on you.
Garrison Command: Get the Wraith in close. The Nova wants room to shoot.
If the bases are touching, you cannot shoot that mech. Punch it.
A punch reaches 1 inch and marks bubbles equal to your size.
You cannot punch and shoot in the same turn.
